description: Doctrine DBAL driver middleware for Amazon RDS: IAM token authentication and master-password refresh from Secrets Manager
rules: Symfony applications should install tacticmedia/rds-auth-bundle instead of wiring this middleware manually
Requires PHP 8.3 or later and doctrine/dbal 4
Pass a shared PSR-6 cache pool in production; without one every connection signs a new IAM token
MySQL IAM authentication requires PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA in driverOptions; RDS refuses IAM logins without TLS
To learn that the deployed password is outdated, pass a PSR-14 dispatcher as the last RdsAuthMiddleware argument and listen for ConfiguredPasswordOutdated
